source.title: Experimental study of ignited unsteady hydrogen releases from a high pressure reservoir
source.target: Figure 2 measured pressure decay for the 4 mm, approximately 200 bar release

search_actions: checked KITopen publication metadata and associated-document links
checked the publisher article record for downloadable supplementary data
checked the public H2Tools conference-paper copy for a machine-readable trace
did not treat plotted calculated curves as measured outcomes
checked the author/article request record for an alternate full-text or data attachment
checked the related Zenodo ventilation release as a possible replacement source

related_zenodo_ventilation_release.reason: The release contains H2 concentration and flow-field/ventilation workbooks, not the 0.37 L reservoir pressure-decay trace required by the Grune holdout.

eligibility.reason: The public records expose publication metadata, apparatus details and figure-level descriptions but no rights-cleared pressure-time table. The existing digitized curve does not reach the required half-pressure endpoint, so no additional endpoint may be inferred.

next_action: Request the original pressure-time logger export and reuse terms from the KIT custodian; freeze a new protocol before reading numerical outcomes.
claim_boundary: This is a data-access recheck only. It neither validates nor invalidates the release model and does not support ignition, radiation, dispersion or safety-distance claims.
